methods.cpu: Sum threadCPUDelta using meta units for samples in [start,end); ignore each thread first delta. Do not multiply by sample weight. CPU is measured per interval; stack attribution is an endpoint estimate, especially misleading at a blocking leaf.
methods.inclusive: Each function receives interval CPU once per sampled stack; recursion does not multiply flat function totals. Inclusive values overlap.
methods.self: Deepest physical symbol receives interval CPU; blocked-observation self attribution is reported separately and is not syscall execution cost.
methods.active_observation_legacy_key: active_observation_self_top30 contains endpoints not recognized by the native wait classifier. It is not proof that every listed function was executing throughout its CPU interval.
methods.wall_weights: Nominal sampling residence uses weight*interval. Clipped values model each row over [time-weight*interval,time]; raw selected weights also retained. These are sampling estimates, not measured call durations.
methods.zero_CPU_residence: For zero-CPU rows, intersect [previous serialized sample time,current time] with crop. Samply reuses/compresses an unchanged stack when OS thread CPU has not advanced. This proves zero reported CPU over the interval, subject to timer resolution.
methods.symbols: Exact sampled RVA to sidecar known_addresses; match library debug name plus Mach-O UUID. Rank physical symbols using library UUID plus physical symbol RVA, keeping same-named distinct symbols separate. Sidecar deduplicates debug frame arrays by physical function RVA, so retain outer representative source locations without assigning CPU to inline frames. Unresolved libraries/addresses retain module and hex location.
methods.observation_groups: Assign each attributed CPU interval once: recognized native blocking endpoint; camera-culling ancestry; directional-shadow-culling ancestry; indirect-draw-validation ancestry; Apple driver leaf; other render-command ancestry; other/unresolved. Groups are exclusive endpoint estimates, not exact function execution cost. Future::poll is never treated as a native blocking syscall.
methods.limits: Line-table debug/LTO and sampling can omit or merge functions; representative sidecar source lines are not per-sample line execution cost. Blocking CPU attribution includes work earlier in the interval. CPU delta can cross crop boundaries; start included and end omitted upper uncertainty recorded. Stack residence is per thread and cannot be added to frame time. CPU sampling does not measure GPU pass execution.

limits: CPU deltas at blocking endpoints are kept separate from nonblocking endpoint groups.
No ordinary per-frame CPU denominator is supplied; compare core equivalents or CPU ms per second.
Sampling loss is not exposed by this producer; resolved and unresolved leaf CPU are retained.

caveats: HUD values are rounded. One exact adjacent doublet is retained per observation; equal observations are never globally deduplicated.
HUD header counters are not validated as engine frame IDs, and these observations are not independently matched to engine frames.
Windows select complete HUD batches by emission time, not exact per-frame timestamps. The first batch can refer to presents just before the start cutoff.

The selected start is capture plus 30 seconds for both HUD and saved CPU analyses. Loading queues are not observed in ordinary captures; neither 30 seconds nor the drawable warmup proves loading complete.

Production V4 has no temporary-control or physical-window log. The comparison uses its actual Fifo 3200x1800 render surface and pinned production source/receipt evidence. Effective AlwaysOnTop state, window position and production scale factor are not asserted.
Run source snapshots explicitly do not prove binary/source identity independently. The final source hashes and production receipt are retained as owner provenance, with that limit.
Standard HUD GPU duration measures command-buffer execution timestamps and may include idle or overlap. It is not active GPU time or utilization and cannot be added to CPU time or inverted into FPS.
This is one ordinary baseline/final observation, with Fifo behavior recorded separately from the renderer's CPU cost. It does not establish repeatability or isolate GPU work.
